Tells  many interesting facts about moon and projects example, how many moon drifting away, we have moon cars, NASA brought 382 kg moon rock and soil, moon Shaked for more than 3 hours many more.

details:
Flight to Moon is a scratch story about the machines NASA left on the Moon. I am in 4th grade,9 year old. I created this story using a cartoon astronaut who explain machines on Moon including LM ,Laser Panel, Moon cars, ALSEP and many more (rangers and surveyor) . It is scratch code based story and in the end I have added small quiz. Space attracts many school going kids but when they access any detail ,they find it difficult to understand due to technicalities.

This Animated story will help them to understand and will interest them to learn more.
